featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely pathetic and insulting experience at Punnet Cars, Chembur. I walked in with full intention to buy a Tata car, but the sales staff treated me as if I wasn’t even worth their time. No interest in showing cars, no test drive offered, and shockingly, a brochure given to me was taken away mid-way and handed to someone else—this is the level of disrespect here.
It didn’t stop there. I was actually confronted over a phone call for simply stating the truth about their behavior. When I returned to speak to the manager, the attitude was equally careless and irresponsible. The response I got was basically “do whatever you want,” which clearly shows how little they care about customers.
This is not bad service—this is outright humiliation of a customer. If this is how Tata dealerships treat serious buyers, it’s no surprise customers lose trust. I would strongly advise anyone to avoid this showroom unless you’re ready to be disrespected.

featured_reviews.name: Prashant Ogania
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am writing to express my disappointment while doing Pre Delivery Inspection (PDI) of my new Tata Nexon Facelift 2025 conducted on 20/10/2025.

During the inspection, I noticed a visible dent on the front door driver-side, which is completely unacceptable in a brand-new vehicle. Attaching a photo for proof.

Due to this issue, I have not signed the delivery documents and have chosen to withhold acceptance of the car until this matter is resolved to my satisfaction.
I expect Puneet dealership (Chembur branch) to rectify the dent in such a way that it becomes entirely unnoticeable, WITHOUT compromising the overall PAINT QUALITY, COLOR TONE, or surface finish. The entire door panel should undergo a proper paint job to ensure uniformity with the rest of the car, both in color and texture.

Please inform the service team in advance to NOT do “Thuk-Pati” local quality work.

However, my strong recommendation is to replace the entire front driver-side door panel with a new one to maintain factory quality standards.

Please note that during the next inspection, if any additional defects—whether exterior, interior, mechanical, or electrical—are found, I will have no option but to involve TATA Motors officials in this issue.

Kindly confirm the corrective action you plan to take and share a clear timeline for when the issue will be fully resolved.

This experience has been truly disappointing, especially coming from a Puneet dealership, a brand known for its quality and trust.

featured_reviews.name: Praful Sapale
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wurst….. wurst….. wurst….👆👆👆
As a new Tata customer, I expected a smooth and professional service, but the experience was completely unsatisfactory. There was a lack of proper communication, delays in service, and overall poor customer handling.

The vehicle was not serviced to the expected standard, and I did not feel that the concerns were properly addressed. This is not the level of service one expects from Tata Motors, especially for a first service which is very important for customer trust.

I request Tata Motors to take this matter seriously and ensure better service quality and customer experience at their service centers.

1) I had a very bad experience of their service - my Tata safari car has leak of coolant as its gasket valve were leaky ( which is a rare case) - they took my car for repairs took one week to repair. Last week they called me for sending car on service and i said ok for Sunday - on sunday they called and said that its not possible as they are under maintance schedule and promised to take car on Thursday this week and arrange a pick up . today is saturday and still no sight or sound from them .
Tata is a good company but is spooling its reputation by appointing unprofessional vendors

featured_reviews.name: Yash Majithia
featured_reviews.review_text: I'm very grateful to Shreenath Hyundai and Mr. Deepak Koyri for their outstanding service. It has been nearly a decade and a half since we first came in contact and I have had a fantastic experience buying two cars from them (i20 in 2011 and Venue in 2019), now hopefully onto my third car from Shreenath. One great thing about Shreenath and their team is that they're extremely transparent about everything and they are patient with you when you are in the process of buying your car - wherein, sometimes you might change your mind about the variants or the model itself and they have multiple conversations with you to ensure that you are satisfied with what you are buying as they understand that buying a car is a big deal and its a product you will use every day for 5-10 years. They understand their customers' relationship with cars and give their honest suggestions about which variant is the most value for money. They're not always trying to sell you the most expensive variant. I am truly grateful to this wonderful dealership for always doing a wonderful job - not only with the sales but after sales service as well.

featured_reviews.name: vicky Bhadange
featured_reviews.review_text:
Car Delivery Review – Skoda Kylac Signature Plus - 30th Nov 2025.
Yesterday, I took delivery of my Skoda Kylac Signature Plus, and I wanted to share my appreciation for the entire process and the amazing team at the showroom.

A big thank you to Aniket, who, despite being new to the system, handled all my queries with patience and ensured every call was attended to. He made the entire purchase process smooth and comfortable.

Special mention to Ajit Gupta, who offered me an excellent deal and guided me throughout the journey. Thank you for all the support and clarity.

The Accessories Department deserves a special shoutout — especially Robin, who has genuinely become like a younger brother to me during this process. He guided me with the right choices of accessories, explained everything in detail, and made sure I picked exactly what was best for the car. His dedication, honesty, and friendly nature really stood out.

Also, a heartfelt thanks to Amit, the VP of the showroom, for being extremely kind and patiently answering all my questions. His professionalism and warmth truly made the experience even better.

The entire staff was polite, supportive, and took great care of my family during the delivery, making the moment special for all of us.

One small request — please look into the Apple CarPlay / Apple Car Connect issue. It’s a minor concern, and I’m confident your team will resolve it soon.

Looking forward to more collaborations for future purchases for myself and my family.
Thank you once again for the wonderful experience.
Keep rocking, and all the best to the entire team!

featured_reviews.review_text:

CEAT produces over 15 million tyres a year and offers the widest range of tyres to all segments and manufactures world-class radials for: heavy-duty trucks and buses, light commercial vehicles, earthmovers, forklifts, tractors, trailers, cars, motorcycles and scooters as well as auto-rickshaws.

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Chavan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Worst experience ever with Gaurav Motors. First they gave us a quotation of ₹1,06,000 and we booked the scooty based on that. But on the delivery date they suddenly said we have to pay ₹3,000 more because “the price changed”. This is completely unprofessional and cheating customers.

Delivery was also given very late, after 8:30 PM, ruining our entire day. Even after that, the problems didn’t stop. They took 3–5 days just to fix the accessories of the scooty, and then almost 15–20 days to provide the number plate. We even had to file a police complaint, and only after the police called the owner did they finally give us our number plate.

And the worst part? The staff is equally rude, unhelpful, and supports the owner in cheating customers. Instead of solving issues, they argue, make excuses, and defend the wrong practices of the dealership. There is absolutely no professionalism, no courtesy, and no transparency.

Totally irresponsible, misleading, and untrustworthy service. I will never recommend Gaurav Motors to anyone.
